description: The drop list of the OD-3 'clean-source book' history line (Rulings PRE-19, PRE-20, PRE-31, OD3P-1): the 12 members of the FINAL FLAG LIST of p9-prereg-flags.md (10 flagged + 2 flagged-unverified; unverified = flagged), absent on the history eras with TRAIN weights carried and no re-fit. OD3P-1: a listed member is treated on every date as the engine treats a member with no data (it adds nothing to the composite; its mass stays in its theme); the TRAIN weights, signs and theme blocks are unchanged. A roles spec names this file as fit.carry.drop: carry_weights.py --drop-list checks and records it, and the roles cycle passes it to the IC exe as --absent-members on the history roles' IC passes (capability absent-members-v1; od3p-absent-contract.md). 'members' is the only key the IC exe reads. 'rules': the P9 rules whose registration's source_sample_end is 2015 or later; the clean-source book applies none of them (PRE-31). 'rules_pending': rules whose registration was not merged when the list was written; carry_weights.py refuses the list until root resolves each from its registration (into 'rules' when its source_sample_end is 2015 or later, else removed) and re-pins this file. Copied by P9 lane OD3P from the committed flag file named in 'source'; no id was added, removed or reordered.
ruling: PRE-31 (adopts the FINAL FLAG LIST as written; PRE-19 unverified = flagged; PRE-20 absent on history, TRAIN weights carried, no re-fit); OD3P-1 (absent = the engine's no-data rule, IC exe --absent-members); ALCLOCK-2 (info-clock-rate-v1: source_sample_end 2019, flagged)
